scope: Generate common_task_name from fine task_name; never change objects or actions

furniture.definition: Furniture, work surfaces and storage furniture; excludes architectural doors, windows, walls and floors.

cosmetics.zh: 化妆品及美容洗护用品
cosmetics.definition: Skincare, makeup and beauty/hair-care products; hair dye and nail polish remain separate. Unqualified medicine, glue or industrial chemicals are excluded.

tableware.definition: Eating/drinking vessels and cutlery; cooking appliances, pots and ambiguous general trays are not automatically classified as tableware.

textile.definition: Non-garment fabric articles; clothing is separate, ambiguous rubber mats/paper wipes are not assigned here.

clothing.definition: Garments and wearable clothing accessories; bedding and non-garment cloth are textile.

stationery.definition: Writing, filing and paper reading materials; electronic information/spreadsheets are not assigned solely by their label.

container.definition: General containers, storage/packaging and their closures; dining vessels take tableware precedence.

body.definition: Human body/regions; hair has a dedicated class for hair work. All existing massage targets group to body as explicitly requested.

hair.definition: Hair and training/artificial hair targets for cutting/combing/perming etc.; hair dye is a material, not hair. Massage uses body instead.

context_rules.apply dye: hair_dye only with hair/wig/barber evidence; otherwise keep dye
context_rules.apply polish: nail_polish only with nail/manicure evidence; otherwise keep polish
context_rules.apply mask: cosmetics only with facial/skincare evidence; otherwise keep mask
context_rules.apply gel or paint: nail_polish with explicit nail context; cosmetics with skincare context; otherwise preserve the noun

fallback: Unlisted nouns retain their fine concept, encoded as snake_case; never silently map all unknown objects to item
